item.title: Vacaville Unified names new superintendent
item.description: The Vacaville Unified School District named Sasha Begell as its next Superintendent of Schools on Tuesday. item.title: Supervisors increase waste rates in unincorporated area
item.description: The Solano County Board of Supervisors voted 4-0 to increase waste collection rates in the unincorporated area by three percent at Tuesday’s meeting. Supervisor John Vasquez was not present at the meeting. Services included in the increase include weekly collections of solid waste, organics and recyclables, drop off events for electronics, hazardous waste and mattresses, […]
